sql_calls.sql: SELECT * FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY audit_ts;
SELECT * FROM store.inventory_book WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY date;
SELECT * FROM store.forecasts WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY date;
SELECT * FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY bill_ts LIMIT 50;

SELECT date_trunc('day', bill_ts)::date AS d,
       count(*) AS lines,
       sum(qty) AS qty,
       count(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG'
  AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30') AS daily_units,
  (SELECT sum(revenue_inr) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30') AS daily_rev,
  (SELECT sum(qty) FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01') AS pos_qty,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01') AS pos_lines,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01') AS pos_bills,
  (SELECT sum(qty*unit_price) FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01') AS pos_amt;
SELECT * FROM store.shelf_audits ORDER BY sku, audit_ts;

SELECT n.nspname AS schema, c.relname AS name,
       CASE c.relkind WHEN 'r' THEN 'table' WHEN 'v' THEN 'view' WHEN 'm' THEN 'matview' ELSE c.relkind::text END AS kind
FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','v','m','f','p')
  AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')
ORDER BY 1,2;
